name: Grignan-les-Adhémar

limits: For red wine, Grenache and Syrah together: at least 70%
For white wine, Viognier: at least 30%
For red and rosé wine, Syrah: 30 to 80%
For red and rosé wine, Grenache: 20 to 70%
For red and rosé wine, Marselan: at most 10%
For red and rosé wine, main grapes together: at least 70%
For red wine, white grapes together: at most 10%
For rosé wine, white grapes together: at most 20%
rules.yield_base: 48 hl/ha for red, 52 for white and rosé

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A Rhône Valley appellation in the Drôme for red, rosé and white wine. Reds are based on Syrah and Grenache, rosés also on Cinsault, and whites on Viognier, Grenache Blanc, Marsanne and Roussanne.
